# Safekeep

> Safekeep is a planned monthly subscription that helps older adults recognize scams through weekly simulated scam texts, emails, and phone calls, with plain-language feedback after each one and a monthly progress report shared with family members they choose. It is scam-awareness education and does not access bank accounts. Plans start at $5/month; enrollment is opening soon via a free waitlist.

## Product

- [Home](https://joinsafekeep.com/): how the weekly simulations and monthly family reports work
- [Pricing](https://joinsafekeep.com/pricing): Individual, Pairs, and Family plans

## Scam alerts

- [This Week's Scam Alert: Midterm Election Scams (October 19, 2026)](https://joinsafekeep.com/scam-alerts/weekly-2026-10-19): The FBI warns of midterm election scams: fake campaign donations, "investment pools," and voter registration texts. How to spot them and what to do.
- [Scams Targeting Seniors in 2026: What the Latest FBI and FTC Data Show](https://joinsafekeep.com/scam-alerts/scams-targeting-seniors-2026): Adults 60+ reported $7.75 billion in scam losses to the FBI in 2025, up 59%. Here are the scams doing the most harm and the warning signs they share.
- [How to Protect Elderly Parents From Scams: A Guide for Adult Children](https://joinsafekeep.com/scam-alerts/how-to-protect-elderly-parents-from-scams): Help an aging parent avoid scams without taking over: how to start the conversation, set a family code word, and add simple bank safeguards.
- [The AI Voice-Cloning Grandparent Scam: How to Tell If It's Really Your Grandchild](https://joinsafekeep.com/scam-alerts/ai-voice-cloning-grandparent-scam): Scammers can copy a grandchild's voice from a short video online. What these calls sound like, and how a family code word helps you check.
- [The Gold Bar Courier Scam and the "Phantom Hacker": How Scammers Talk People Into Moving Their Savings](https://joinsafekeep.com/scam-alerts/phantom-hacker-gold-courier-scam): How gold bar courier scams and the phantom hacker scam convince people to move their savings, the warning signs, and what to do if money is gone.
- [Medicare Scam Calls During Open Enrollment (Oct 15 to Dec 7, 2026): 6 to Hang Up On](https://joinsafekeep.com/scam-alerts/medicare-open-enrollment-scams): Medicare scam calls spike from Oct 15 to Dec 7. Medicare won't call to confirm your number or send a new card. Six common scams and where to report them.

## If you think you've been scammed (U.S.)

- Call your bank using the number on your card, report at https://www.ic3.gov/ and https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/, and call the National Elder Fraud Hotline at 1-833-372-8311.
